title: O My Mind, Remain Awake And Aware
summary: Anxiety is being answered in the middle of pressure, not after the day has calmed down.
takeaway: Siree Raag, Third Mehla:; o my mind, remain awake and aware night and day, and think
lifeApplication: Read one line aloud before trying to solve the whole future. Use the line before the pressure chooses your tone.

source.shortMeaning: Siree Raag, Third Mehla:; o my mind, remain awake and aware night and day, and think
source.lifeApplication: Let the wider line hold together what the mind wants to split apart.

evidence.coreClaim: Siree Raag, Third Mehla:; o my mind, remain awake and aware night and day, and think
evidence.turn: Anxiety steadies when o Nanak, I am a sacrifice to those who are found to be true.
